svg.title: Ruth's pattern: the newest, pinned to be cut
svg.desc: The newest sheet, pinned and ready, embroidery scissors lying on it, every earlier size nested inside the new cut line like growth rings and a column of pencil ticks at one height in the margin; along the selvage eight of Ruth's marks ("I go cold. The play stays still. Company goes home.").

g.text: No. 4 · six seams · same as before, larger
